snippet.title: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown - Mobile Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Try out the game today with our free trial!
Download now on iOS: https://ubi.li/FMDf0
Download now on GGP: https://ubi.li/aWLFh

The critically acclaimed Prince of Persia™: The Lost Crown is now available on mobile! 

The mobile version maintains all the original game's features, with additional features designed specifically for an optimized mobile experience!

Enjoy a fully customizable experience, with the possibility to play offline and run the game smoothly at 60FPS on most recent phones and tablets: 
- 3 different playstyles: original HD, mobile-friendly, or casual, and tweak settings anytime for a personalized experience.
- Customizable touch screen controls
- External controller support
- New accessibility options to let you fine-tune combat and platforming, with auto-actions like Auto-Potion, Auto-Parry, Auto-Hit, and the exclusive Time Lord feature to change the game speed to your liking, as low as 75%.

And it’s only a glimpse of everything that has been added to make Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown a memorable adventure on mobile.
Try it for free and unlock the full adventure with a single in-app purchase!

Prince of Persia™: The Lost Crown is an action-adventure platformer game, inspired by the Metroidvania genre and set in a mythological Persian world. 

Play an epic adventure as Sargon, an extraordinary and fearless young hero. Summoned by Queen Thomyris with your fellow brothers-in-arms, the Immortals, you are sent on a rescue mission to save her son: Prince Ghassan. The trail leads you to Mount Qaf, the ancient city of Gods, now cursed and filled with time-corrupted enemies and inhospitable mythological creatures. To fulfill your quest, you will have to learn to master unique Time Powers, combat and platforming skills to perform deadly combos to defeat your enemies and restore the world's balance. 

Now it's time to save the prince! Let your adventure begin!
